description: This source file contains the implementation of CCITT fax encoding for bitonal images, including both 1D and 2D group 4 encoding methods, with helpers for bit-level reading and writing. It also includes static tables for Huffman codes used in compression.

classes.name: BitReader
classes.description: A helper class for reading bits from an in-memory bitmap file, supporting position setting and bit extraction.

classes.name: BitWriter
classes.description: A helper class for writing bits into a byte array, with buffering and efficient bit-level writing.

methods.name: CountOneBits
methods.description: Counts the consecutive one bits in a line starting at current reader position.

methods.name: CountZeroBits
methods.description: Counts the consecutive zero bits in a line starting at current reader position.

methods.name: FindDifference
methods.description: Finds the position of the next bit different from the current in a range, according to the specified color.

methods.name: FindDifferenceWithCheck
methods.description: Same as FindDifference, with additional handling if start position exceeds end.

methods.name: FaxEncode2DRow
methods.description: Encodes a single row of bitonal image data using 2D CCITT group 4 encoding, referencing previous line if provided.

methods.name: DoFaxEncoding
methods.description: Encodes a monochrome image bitmap with 1D CCITT fax encoding.

methods.name: DoFaxEncodingGroup4
methods.description: Encodes a monochrome image bitmap with 2D CCITT group 4 encoding.

methods.name: WriteSample
methods.description: Writes the Huffman code for a run length of white or black pixels.
